description: Returns real-time presence status for members of a specified team — who is online, their current task, and last activity. Use when the manager asks 'who is online on my team?', 'show me team presence', 'who is currently active?'. Requires a valid team_id UUID. Manager role or above required.

team_id.description: Team UUID to query presence for. Use list_teams to find team IDs.

name: get_team_presence

online_count.description: Number of team members currently online

presence.description: Array of presence objects (userId, name, isOnline, currentTask, lastActivity)

title: Team Presence
